topic: Filing a Renters Insurance Claim for a Stolen Bike

script.title: THE STOLEN BIKE CLAIM
script.scene_zh: 理賠熱線 · 單車竊案
script.story_hook: A locked bike, an empty rack, one careful call.
script.intro_zh: 上鎖的車不見了，只剩空車架，與一通要冷靜打完的理賠電話。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's scene is a claim call. Listen for money words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景是一通自行車失竊理賠電話。留意金錢相關的說法。
script.outro: And the claim is open. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 理賠案順利立案了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: depreciation is math, not an insult
script.char_a_description: an anxious young man in his late twenties with a bleached blond mullet over dark roots, a thin silver chain necklace, an emerald green cycling jersey over a white tee, and a lean build
script.char_b_description: a composed woman in her late forties with a honey blond bob with straight bangs, small gold stud earrings, a teal silk blouse, and a soft reassuring voice

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to file a claim, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ ˈnid tə ˈfaɪl ə ˈkleɪm aɪ ˈθɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想我應該要申請理賠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Are you the person on the policy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs ɑɹ ju ðə ˈpɝsn ɑn ðə ˈpɑləsi/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。請問保單上是您本人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that's me. Owen Delgado, policy seven-one-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts mi ˈoʊən dɛlˈɡɑdoʊ ˈpɑləsi ˈsɛvən wʌn tu/
dialogue.zh: 是的，就是我。歐文·德爾加多，保單七一二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, Owen. What happened, in plain words?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈoʊən wət həˈpænd ɪn pleɪn wɝdz/
dialogue.zh: 好的，歐文。請用最簡單的說法告訴我發生了什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my bike is gone. Stolen last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl maɪ baɪk ɪz ɡɑn ˈstoʊlən læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 唉，我的自行車不見了，昨晚遭竊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. Was it locked up at least?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wəz ɪt lɑkt ʌp əˈlist/
dialogue.zh: 噢，不會吧。起碼它有上鎖吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was! Cable lock, courtyard rack, you see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wəz ˈkeɪbl lɑk ˈkɔɹˌjɑrd ɹæk ju si/
dialogue.zh: 當然！鋼纜鎖，就鎖在中庭的車架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I believe you. When did you notice?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ bɪˈliv ju wɛn dɪd ju ˈnoʊtəs/
dialogue.zh: 好，我相信你。請問您是在什麼時候發現的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This morning, six-ish, cutter marks, empty rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ sɪks ɪʃ ˈkʌɾɚ mɑɹks ˈɛpti ɹæk/
dialogue.zh: 今早六點左右，鎖上有剪痕，車架空空如也。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's rough. Did anyone in the courtyard see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts rʌf dɪd ˈɛniˌwʌn ɪn ðə ˈkɔɹˌjɑrd si/
dialogue.zh: 真糟糕。中庭有沒有人看到什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The janitor saw two guys, but they ran.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdʒænətɚ sɔ tu ɡaɪz bət ðeɹ ɹæn/
dialogue.zh: 管理員看到兩個人，但他們轉身就跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm. So, did you file a police report?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm soʊ dɪd ju faɪl ə pəˈlis rɪˈpɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯。那請問，你報警了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, not yet. Do I need one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈnɑt ˈjɛt du aɪ ˈnid ˈwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 呃，還沒有。這個需要報警嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For theft, yes, it's step one, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ θɛft jɛz ɪts stɛp wʌn ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 竊案一定需要，這是第一步，先跟你說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, where do I even start with that?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wɛɹ du aɪ ˈivən stɑɹt wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我該從哪裡著手報警？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the non-emergency line, they'll give a number.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðə ˈnɑn ˈimɚdʒənsi laɪn ðeɪl ɡiv ə ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 打非緊急專線就好，他們會給你一個案件編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. How does that number help us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt haʊ dʌz ðæt ˈnʌmbɚ hɛlp ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那個編號對理賠有什麼幫助？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It proves the bike existed and then didn't.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pɹuvz ðə baɪk ɪɡˈzɪstəd ænd ðɛn ˈdɪdənt/
dialogue.zh: 它能證明這輛自行車確實存在過，然後又消失了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, dark, but fair. I'll call right after.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dɑɹk bət fɛɹ aɪl kɔl ɹaɪt ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，有點黑色幽默，但有道理。我掛了就打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Meanwhile, what was the bike worth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈminwɛɪl wət wəz ðə baɪk wɝθ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。順便問一下，這輛車價值多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six hundred, bought it new last spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈhʌndɹəd bɑt ɪt nju læst spɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 六百塊，去年春天買全新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Do you have the receipt or photos?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs du ju hæv ðə ɹɪˈsit ɔɹ ˈfoʊtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那你有收據或照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos, tons. Receipt... somewhere in my email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz tʌnz ɹɪˈsit ˈsʌmwɛɹ ɪn maɪ ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 照片一大堆。收據嘛……應該躺在我的郵件裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Email counts. Search the word bike and check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪl kaʊnts sɝtʃ ðə wɝd baɪk ænd tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 郵件收據也算。你搜尋 bike 這個詞看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, found it! Five ninety-nine, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ faʊnd ɪt faɪv ˈnɪnti naɪn hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 好，找到了！上面寫著五百九十九，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we'll attach that to the claim later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wil əˈtætʃ ðæt tə ðə kleɪm ˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 很好，我們稍後會把它附進理賠案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. So, now the money part, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du soʊ naʊ ðə ˈmʌni pɑɹt hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。那麼，現在來到談錢的部分了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, um, here's the honest math.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛz ʌm hɪɹz ði ˈɑnist mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 對，嗯，接下來是誠實的數學時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm bracing myself. Go ahead, hit me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈbɹesɪŋ maɪˈsɛlf ɡoʊ əˈhɛd hɪt mi/
dialogue.zh: 我心理準備好了，請直說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your plan has a hundred-dollar deductible.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ plæn hæz ə ˈhʌndɹəd ˈdɑlə dɪˈdʌktəbl/
dialogue.zh: 你的方案有一百美元的自負額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... so six hundred minus that?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ soʊ sɪks ˈhʌndɹəd ˈmaɪnəs ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 好……那就是六百減掉一百？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not quite. We pay the used value.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt kwaɪt wi peɪ ðə juzd ˈvælju/
dialogue.zh: 沒那麼簡單。我們賠的是使用後的價值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Used value? So, what it sells for now?
dialogue.phonetic: /juzd ˈvælju soʊ wət ɪt sɛlz fɔɹ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 使用後的價值？就是它現在堪用的價錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. Picture maybe four-fifty after the deductible.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ˈpɪkʧɚ ˈmeɪbi ˈfɔɹ ˈfɪfti ˈæftɚ ðə dɪˈdʌktəbl/
dialogue.zh: 對。扣掉自負額後，數字大概落在四百五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, four-fifty. Ouch, that stings a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈfɔɹ ˈfɪfti aʊtʃ ðæt stɪŋz ə ˈlɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，四百五。嘖，還是有點心痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know. Bikes lose value like phones do.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ baɪks luz ˈvælju laɪk foʊnz du/
dialogue.zh: 我懂。自行車就像手機一樣會一天天掉價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's true, my phone is worth nothing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts tɹu maɪ foʊn ɪz wɝθ ˈnʌθɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是，我的手機現在根本不值錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Depreciation is math, not an insult.
dialogue.phonetic: /si diˌpɹiʃiˈeɪʃən ɪz mæθ nɑt ən ˈɪnsʌlt/
dialogue.zh: 你看，折舊只是數學算出來的，不是故意氣你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, you're okay at pep talks, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jʊɹ ˈoʊkeɪ æt pɛp tɔks hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，你安慰人的功力還不錯嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I try. One more detail: the lock brand?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɹaɹ wʌn mɔɹ ˈditeɪl ðə lɑk bɹænd/
dialogue.zh: 我盡力而為。再多一個細節：鎖是什麼牌子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kryptonite, heavy duty, still got cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɪptənaɪt ˈhævi ˈdudi stɪl ɡɑt kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 是 Kryptonite，很厚實的那種，結果還是斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry to say, lock details affect approval.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi tə seɪ lɑk ˈditeɪlz əˈfɛkt əˈpɹuvəl/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉要這麼說，鎖的細節會影響審核結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Can I also claim a rental bike?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ kleɪm ə ˈɹɛnɾəl baɪk/
dialogue.zh: 合理。那我可以另外申請租賃自行車的費用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, let me check... no, your plan doesn't.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm lɛt mi tʃɛk noʊ jɔɹ plæn ˈdəzənt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我查一下……不行，你的方案不包這筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way. Then how do I get to work?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈweɪ ðɛn ˈhaʊ du aɪ ˈɡɛt tə ˈwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧。那我之後怎麼去上班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The payout moves fast though, about five days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪˌaʊt muz fæst ðoʊ əˈbaʊt faɪv deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 不過理賠金撥得很快，大約五天就會下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five days, huh. Okay, I can work with that.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv deɪz hʌ oʊˈkeɪ aɪ kæn wɝk wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 五天啊。好吧，這個條件我可以接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And keep every message about the theft, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kip ˈɛvɹi ˈmɛsɪdʒ əˈbaʊt ðə θɛft pliz/
dialogue.zh: 還有，關於失竊的每一則訊息都請留好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos, emails, the police number. Got the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈimeɪlz ðə pəˈlis ˈnʌmbɚ ɡɑt ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 照片、郵件、報案編號，清單我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. I'll email the claim link today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪl ˈimeɪl ðə kleɪm lɪŋk təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我今天會把理賠連結寄給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, my inbox is scared enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ maɪ ˈɪnˌbɑks ɪz skɛrd ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛剛好，我的信箱已經夠驚心動魄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your claim number is R-nineteen, four-four-six.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ kleɪm ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz ˈɑɹ naɪnˈtin ˈfɔɹ fɔɹ sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 你的理賠案號是 R 一九，四四六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: R nineteen four four six... written down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑɹ naɪnˈtin fɔɹ fɔɹ sɪks ˈɹɪtn daʊn/
dialogue.zh: R 一九四四六……寫下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's your ticket, save it in your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts jɔɹ ˈtɪkɪt seɪv ɪt ɪn jɔɹ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那就是你的入場券，趕快存進手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already done. Hey, thanks for the straight talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈɛdi dʌn heɪ θæŋks fɚ ðə stɹeɪt tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 已經存好了。對了，真心感謝你跟我說實話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for staying calm about it, Owen.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ ˈsteɪɪŋ kɑm əˈbaʊt ɪt ˈoʊən/
dialogue.zh: 也要感謝你全程都這麼冷靜，歐文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five days, used value, police first. Crystal clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv deɪz juzd ˈvælju pəˈlis fɝst ˈkɹɪstəl klɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 五天、使用後的價值、先報警。非常清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got it. Enjoy the rest of your day.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɡɑt ɪt ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə rɛst əv jɔɹ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你全搞定了。祝你今天剩下的時間順心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Bye, and thanks for the math.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ ænd ˈθæŋks fɚ ðə ˈmæθ/
dialogue.zh: 會的。再見，也謝謝你陪我算這筆帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Owen, hope the courtyard's quieter tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈoʊən hoʊp ðə ˈkɔɹˌjɑrdz ˈkwaɪətɚ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再見歐文，希望今晚的中庭安靜一點。

script.youtube_title_en: "Depreciation Is Math, Not an Insult" — Filing a Stolen Bike Claim
script.youtube_description:
「折舊只是數學，不是故意氣你」——上了鎖的自行車在中庭車架上過夜後消失，那通理賠電話到底要怎麼打？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在保險公司的理賠熱線上。

你會聽到：開場報出保單號與案情；理賠專員一步步教你先報警、拿案件編號；搜尋郵件裡的收據；接著是最難的數學：自負額與使用後價值的算法，從六百塊一路算到實拿四百五。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人講錢時最真實的客套與坦誠：um、well、so、ouch、no way。聽完你就會用：file a claim、step one、deductible、payout。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱頻道並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Depreciation is math, not an insult" — your locked commuter bike vanished from the courtyard overnight, and now you have to make the call. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set entirely on a renters insurance claim call.

You will hear: opening with your policy number, describing the theft in plain words, learning that the police report comes first, hunting down the email receipt, and the honest money math: deductibles and used value instead of what you paid new.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, ouch, no way. By the end you'll own phrases like file a claim, step one, deductible, and payout in five days.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
上了鋼纜鎖的自行車一夜消失，理賠電話該怎麼開口？為什麼一定要先報警？六百塊買的新車，為什麼賠四百五？

這一集帶大家打一通完整的自行車失竊理賠電話，從報出保單號、描述案情、拿報案編號、搜尋收據郵件，一路聽到算清自負額與使用後價值，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📞 開場立案：Hi, I need to file a claim, I think.
🚨 報警指引：Call the non-emergency line, they'll give a number.
💸 誠實數學：Your plan has a hundred-dollar deductible.
🧮 價值說明：Not quite. We pay the used value.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通電話走完一遍，下次你真的需要理賠時，每一句話都說得出口。

祝你永遠用不上這通電話，但聽完就不怕它。
